propositions: Contributor sign-off guidance currently hardcodes a specific bot identity (Joe Oakhart) instead of directing contributors to use their own configured git identity, contradicting the project's DCO policy.
Documentation files AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/rebar.md, and CONTRIBUTING.md contain conflicting instructions about which identity to use for Signed-off-by commits.

A deterministic lint check must be added to detect and fail the build if hardcoded personal sign-off identities are reintroduced in contributor-facing documentation, while excluding automation-owned paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/, docs/experiments/).

All contributor-facing guidance must consistently describe the DCO contract as requiring the committer's own configured git identity, with bot identities retained only in narrowly scoped automation documentation.
The remediation requires updating AGENTS.md and .agents/rules/rebar.md to reference git config user.name and user.email, removing Joe Oakhart identity from general contribution guidance.
